description: A high-level Go module for interacting with the GitHub API

highlights.description: **Repository access listing**: `repo.ListNonMemberOrgRepos` answers "which repositories have I been granted access to in organizations I don't belong to?", backed by new `clientv1` methods for the authenticated user's repositories and organization memberships, and exposed as the `gogithub repo-access` CLI command

**OAuth app authentication via goauth**: organizations can forbid personal access tokens; the new `auth/credentialsset` package obtains an OAuth app token from a goauth credentials set file using the authorization code grant, and `errors.IsTokenPolicyError` plus `repo.CheckAccess` make the policy block visible instead of looking like a missing repository

added.description: [clientv1] `ListAuthenticatedUserRepos(ctx, opts)` wraps `GET /user/repos`, including private and collaborator-granted repositories, with `Visibility` and `Affiliations` filters; results include `Repository.Permissions`
[clientv1] `ListOrgMemberships(ctx, opts)` wraps `GET /user/memberships/orgs`, with a `State` filter
[types] `Repository.Permissions` with `RepositoryPermissions.Highest()`, `OrgMembership`, and constants for owner types, permission levels, membership states, and repository affiliations
[errors] `IsTokenPolicyError(err)` detects a 403 caused by an organization policy that rejects the token type (e.g. classic PATs forbidden); `Message(err)` extracts the message GitHub returned
[repo] `ListNonMemberOrgRepos`, `FilterNonMemberOrgRepos`, and `MembershipOrgLogins` list and filter repositories owned by organizations the user is not an active member of
[repo] `CheckAccess(ctx, client, owner, name)` reports access to one repository as `granted`, `not_visible`, or `blocked_by_token_policy`, probing the owner on a 404 to tell the last two apart

[auth/credentialsset] `NewClient` and `NewToken` create clients from a goauth credentials set account, using a stored token or the authorization code grant via an `AuthCodePrompt`; `PromptReadWriter` provides a command-line prompt and `RedirectURL` the hosted redirect page

[cli] `gogithub repo-access` lists accessible repositories with permission levels; `--non-member-orgs` filters to organizations the user is not a member of, `--repo owner/name` checks specific repositories, `--creds`/`--account` authenticate as an OAuth app, and `-f json` emits JSON

changed.description: [cliutil] `GitStatusShortLines` runs git in the target directory with `-C` instead of changing the process working directory, uses the stable porcelain format, and omits empty lines; `GitRmDeletedLines` returns commands without trailing newlines and `GitRmDeletedFile` replaces the output file

fixed.description: [cliutil] `bulk_git_rm` takes the repository directory as `--dir` (default: current directory) instead of a hardcoded local path, and prints `git rm` commands to stdout or to `--out`

dependencies.description: Added `github.com/grokify/goauth` v0.25.0 for credentials set files and OAuth flows, imported only by `auth/credentialsset`; bumped `mogo`, `gocharts`, and `golang.org/x` modules

Added coverage badge to README

highlights.description: **clientv1 gains branch protection, repo languages, GitHub Actions, and rate-limit APIs**: `GetBranchProtection`, `ListLanguages`, `ListWorkflows`, `ListWorkflowRuns`, `GetRateLimit`, `ListUserReposWithOptions`, `EditIssueComment`, and `ListIssueComments` close the gaps hit migrating a CI/CD pipeline collector and a dependency-graph/release-automation tool off raw `*github.Client` usage

added.description: [clientv1] `GetBranchProtection(ctx, owner, repo, branch)` returns branch protection settings, or `(nil, nil)` if unprotected
[clientv1] `ListLanguages(ctx, owner, repo)` returns languages used in a repository mapped to bytes of code
[clientv1] `ListWorkflows` and `ListWorkflowRuns` wrap the GitHub Actions API; `ListWorkflowRuns` deliberately does not auto-paginate, since a long-lived workflow can accumulate thousands of runs
[clientv1] `ListUserReposWithOptions(ctx, user, opts)` filters a user's repositories by relationship (`owner`, `member`, or `all`); `ListUserRepos` is now defined in terms of it
[clientv1] `GetRateLimit(ctx)` returns the core (non-search) API rate limit status
[clientv1] `EditIssueComment` and `ListIssueComments` round out issue/PR comment management
[errors] `IsRateLimitError(err)` detects a go-github `*RateLimitError`/`*AbuseRateLimitError` on a raw error returned directly from a clientv1 call, without requiring `Translate` first
[types] `Repository.Topics` and `Repository.Visibility`; `BranchProtection`, `RequiredStatusChecks`, `PullRequestReviewsEnforcement`, `Workflow`, `WorkflowRun`, `RateLimit`, `EventRepo` stable types

highlights.description: `gogithub.PullRequest` gained an `Assignees` field, closing another gap where consumers needing PR assignees had to fall back to raw go-github types

fixed.description: [types] `PullRequest.Assignees` (`[]*gogithub.User`) mirrors go-github's `PullRequest.Assignees`, previously dropped by the stable type

highlights.description: **clientv1 gains Activity API coverage**: `ListUserEvents` wraps go-github's user-events timeline behind a stable `gogithub.Event`/`EventRepo` type, closing the last gap that forced activity-heatmap consumers to import go-github directly

documentation.description: [clientv1] Documented `ListUserEvents` and the `Event`/`EventRepo` types in the version-isolated client guide

highlights.description: **Version-isolation architecture completed**: `clientv1.Client` and stable `gogithub.*` types now cover the full GitHub API surface used by this module's own packages (`search`, `repo`, `sarif`)

**clientv1 expanded to full API coverage**: file content writes, Git tree/blob operations for atomic multi-file commits, issue CRUD, and code search were added on top of the initial repositories/PRs/releases/checks coverage

**Breaking**: `search`, `repo`, and `sarif` packages now accept `clientv1.Client` instead of `*github.Client`; legacy `auth`/`config` helpers exposing go-github types are deprecated in favor of `clientv1`

breaking.description: `sarif` package functions (`Upload`, `UploadFile`, `GetUploadStatus`, `WaitForProcessing`, `UploadAndWait`) now accept `clientv1.Client` instead of `*github.Client`

added.description: [clientv1] Version-isolated `Client` interface and stable types wrapping go-github (users, repos, content, refs, commits, PRs, checks, releases)
[types] Stable types for version isolation (`User`, `Repository`, `Reference`, `Commit`, `PullRequest`, `CheckRun`, `Release`, etc.)
[clientv1] Expanded API coverage: forks, git refs/tags, `CreateCommit`/`CreateTree`, PR reviews/comments/merge, issue comments, check suites, release CRUD, `SearchIssues`, contributor stats
[clientv1] `NewClientWithOptions()` for GitHub Enterprise support (custom BaseURL/UploadURL)

[clientv1] File content writes (`CreateFile`, `UpdateFile`, `DeleteFile`, `GetFileContentWithSHA`) and Git Data API tree/blob operations (`GetTree`, `CreateBlob`) plus a `Tree` field on `Commit`, enabling atomic multi-file commits entirely through clientv1

[clientv1] Issue CRUD (`GetIssue`, `ListIssues`, `CreateIssue`, `UpdateIssue`) and `SearchCode`; `PullRequest` gained `Labels`/`Additions`/`Deletions`/`Commits`, `Issue` gained `Comments`/`IsPullRequest`

highlights.description: Major architecture refactor: reorganized into modular subpackages by operation type
Added comprehensive GitHub API operations for repositories, pull requests, and releases
Maintained backward compatibility with v0.2.x API (deprecated, will be removed in v0.4.0)

added.description: New `errors` package with standard error types (`ErrNotFound`, `ErrPermissionDenied`, `ErrRateLimited`, etc.) and `Translate` function
New `config` package with `Config` struct, `FromEnv`, `FromEnvWithConfig`, GitHub Enterprise support
New `pathutil` package with `Validate`, `Normalize`, `Join`, `Split`, `Dir`, `Base`, `Ext`, `HasPrefix` functions
New `auth` package with `NewGitHubClient`, `GetAuthenticatedUser`, `GetUser` functions
New `search` package with `Client`, `SearchIssues`, `SearchIssuesAll`, `Query` builder, and `Issues` type with table generation
New `repo` package with fork operations (`EnsureFork`, `GetDefaultBranch`)
New `repo` package with branch operations (`CreateBranch`, `GetBranchSHA`, `DeleteBranch`, `BranchExists`)
New `repo` package with commit operations (`CreateCommit`, `ReadLocalFiles`, `FileContent` type)
New `repo` package with listing operations (`ListOrgRepos`, `ListUserRepos`, `GetRepo`, `ParseRepoName`)
New `repo` package with batch operations (`Batch` type for atomic multi-file commits)
New `pr` package with `CreatePR`, `GetPR`, `ListPRs`, `MergePR`, `ClosePR`, `AddPRReviewers`, `ListPRFiles`, `ListPRComments`
New `release` package with `ListReleases`, `ListReleasesSince`, `GetRelease`, `GetLatestRelease`, `GetReleaseByTag`, `ListReleaseAssets`
New `cliutil` package with `GitStatusShortLines`, `GitRmDeletedLines`, `GitRmDeletedFile` helpers
Example command `cmd/searchuserpr` for searching user pull requests

changed.description: Reorganized codebase from flat package structure to modular subpackages by operation type
Root package now provides backward-compatible re-exports delegating to subpackages
Moved search functionality from `api_search.go` to `search/search.go`
Moved constants from `constants.go` to `search/query.go`
Moved issue types from `issue.go` to `search/issues.go`
Moved example command from `pullrequest/cmd/searchuserpr` to `cmd/searchuserpr`

deprecated.description: Root package `Client` type - use `auth.NewGitHubClient` and subpackage clients directly
Root package type aliases (`Query`, `Issues`, `Issue`) - import from `search` package directly
Root package constant re-exports (`ParamUser`, `ParamState`, etc.) - import from `search` package directly
Root package wrapper methods (`SearchOpenPullRequests`, `SearchIssues`, `SearchIssuesAll`) - use `search.Client` methods directly

Added missing v0.3.0 packages to README documentation
